sentences.zh: 你好，珍娜。

sentences.en: Today, we're breaking down The Sting.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要解析的是《诱饵》这一集。

sentences.en: It is Season 7, Episode 5, written by Mindy Kaling and directed by Randall Einhorn.
sentences.zh: 这是第七季第五集，由敏迪·卡灵编剧，兰德尔·艾因霍恩执导。

sentences.en: I'm excited for this one.
sentences.zh: 我很期待这一集。

sentences.en: I'm excited for so many reasons.
sentences.zh: 我期待的原因有很多。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Well, let me start with a summary.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我先来做个剧情梗概。

sentences.en: A handsome salesman from a rival paper company has been stealing Dunder Mifflin's clients.
sentences.zh: 一家竞争对手造纸公司的帅气推销员一直在抢邓德·米夫林的客户。

sentences.en: So Michael stages an elaborate sting operation to learn his secrets.
sentences.zh: 于是迈克尔策划了一场精心设计的诱饵行动，想要套出他的秘密。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Andy starts a band with Daryl and Kevin after learning his less-talented former classmate, Broccoli Rob, has had a taste of musical success.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，安迪在得知他那位才华平平的昔日同学“西兰花罗布”尝到了音乐成功的滋味后，便与达里尔和凯文组建了一支乐队。

sentences.en: Kelsey Yum!
sentences.zh: 凯尔西美味！

sentences.en: And Broccoli Rob has a commercial called Kelsey Yum!
sentences.zh: 而且西兰花罗布还拍了一个叫“凯尔西美味”的广告！

sentences.en: For the milk company.
sentences.zh: 是为那家牛奶公司拍的。

sentences.en: Yeah, which cracked me up because Phyllis was like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 没错，这让我笑喷了，因为菲利斯当时说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: That's a really good reminder.
sentences.zh: 这真是个很好的提醒。

sentences.en: I need to drink milk.
sentences.zh: 我得喝点牛奶了。

sentences.en: You know, I was the voice of, like, cheese, Wisconsin cheese for a year.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我曾有一年是威斯康星奶酪的代言人。

sentences.en: What was your catchphrase?
sentences.zh: 你的广告语是什么？

sentences.en: I can't remember if we had a catchphrase, but for a year, I recorded commercials for Wisconsin cheese and talked about grilled cheese sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 我不记得有没有广告语了，但有一年，我录制了威斯康星奶酪的广告，还谈到了烤奶酪三明治。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I wonder if they exist anywhere.
sentences.zh: 不知道这些广告现在还能不能找到。

sentences.en: That makes me so happy.
sentences.zh: 这让我太开心了。

sentences.en: Well, listen, today, our fast facts are once again, for the third week in a row, an interview.
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，今天我们的“速览事实”环节，连续第三周又是采访环节。

sentences.en: You guys, we are so excited.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我们太激动了。

sentences.en: Guess who's here?
sentences.zh: 猜猜谁来了？

sentences.en: We've been wanting this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们期待这一刻很久了。

sentences.en: It's Craig Robinson!
sentences.zh: 是克雷格·罗宾逊！

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: We have been wanting this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们真的期待这一刻很久了。

sentences.en: He is busy, but he is here today, and I am so excited.
sentences.zh: 他很忙，但他今天来了，我太兴奋了。

sentences.en: And we are going to ask him everything.
sentences.zh: 我们要问他所有的问题。

sentences.en: Who is this?
sentences.zh: 这是谁？

sentences.en: Who's on my screen right now?
sentences.zh: 现在出现在我屏幕上的是谁？

sentences.en: Hello, office ladies!
sentences.zh: 你们好，办公室女士们！

sentences.en: Hi, Craig!
sentences.zh: 嗨，克雷格！

sentences.en: What's up, Craig?
sentences.zh: 怎么样，克雷格？

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近好吗？

sentences.en: It's going good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: Oh my God, it's so good to see your face.
sentences.zh: 天哪，见到你真好。

sentences.en: Likewise.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: What's up over there?
sentences.zh: 那边怎么了？

sentences.en: What is this I'm looking at?
sentences.zh: 我看到的这是什么？

sentences.en: You're looking at our office ladies studio here at Earwolf.
sentences.zh: 你看到的是我们 Earwolf 的《办公室》女士工作室。

sentences.en: With lots of lamps, because we can't see anymore.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多台灯，因为我们视力不行了。

sentences.en: Yeah, we each get our own lamp at office ladies.
sentences.zh: 没错，在《办公室》女士工作室，我们每个人都有自己的台灯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Only the beSt.
sentences.zh: 只用最好的。

sentences.en: Only the best!
sentences.zh: 只用最好的！

sentences.en: Very nice.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: Very nice.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: Well, Craig, we're going to jump right in.
sentences.zh: 好了，克雷格，我们要直接开始了。

sentences.en: We always ask our guests, how did they get their job on the office?
sentences.zh: 我们总是问嘉宾，你是怎么得到《办公室》这份工作的？

sentences.en: I auditioned.
sentences.zh: 我去试镜了。

sentences.en: It was Greg Daniels, and then there must have been 12 other people in the room,
sentences.zh: 当时格雷格·丹尼尔斯在场，房间里大概还有其他12个人，

sentences.en: and I read one of the confessionals.
sentences.zh: 我读了其中一段访谈戏的台词。

sentences.en: Yeah, the talking heads to camera.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是对着镜头的独白。

sentences.en: I read one of the talking heads.
sentences.zh: 我读了其中一段独白。

sentences.en: And the beauty of my audition, the beauty and also terror, was when I walked in.
sentences.zh: 我那次试镜的美妙之处，或者说美妙又恐怖之处，就是我走进去的时候。

sentences.en: At that time, I had a video out with Jerry Minor.
sentences.zh: 当时，我和杰瑞·迈纳出过一个视频。

sentences.en: It was a song called Somebody's Fing My Lady.
sentences.zh: 那是一首叫《有人在搞我的女人》的歌。

sentences.en: Yes, very familiar.
sentences.zh: 是的，很熟悉。

sentences.en: We know it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道那首歌。

sentences.en: You know, making rounds and stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，到处流传之类的。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is, obviously, people look at your work before you come in to see
sentences.zh: 而且，显然人们在见你之前会先看你的作品，

sentences.en: what they're dealing with kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 看看他们要面对的是什么样的人。

sentences.en: But at that time, I didn't realize people were, like, looking at your work.
sentences.zh: 但当时我没意识到人们会看你的作品。

sentences.en: I just thought you just went in.
sentences.zh: 我以为只要走进去就行了。

sentences.en: And Greg Daniels was like, I saw the song.
sentences.zh: 结果格雷格·丹尼尔斯说，我看了那首歌的视频。

sentences.en: It doesn't get any funnier than that.
sentences.zh: 没有比那更好笑的了。

sentences.en: And so that could either, you could take that two ways.
sentences.zh: 所以这事儿你可以有两种解读。

sentences.en: Hey, you know, you're in, you know, and just go have a good time.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你知道，你稳了，去好好表现就行。

sentences.en: Or, wow, you're going to really mess this up now.
sentences.zh: 或者，哇，你现在要是搞砸了可就完了。

sentences.en: Yeah, because you had peaked already.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为你已经达到巅峰了。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实。

sentences.en: So I was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧。

sentences.en: But thankfully, you know, they laughed and came out as Daryl.
sentences.zh: 但谢天谢地，他们笑了，最后我成了达里尔。

sentences.en: Now, when you got the role as Daryl, did you know that it was going to be recurring?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你得到达里尔这个角色时，你知道它会是常驻角色吗？

sentences.en: Had they already decided that?
sentences.zh: 他们当时已经决定了吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't think all of that was out there yet.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得当时还没定下来。

sentences.en: I do not know, to be perfectly honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我真的不知道。

sentences.en: But, you know, I didn't pop up.
sentences.zh: 不过，我当时并没有频繁出现。

sentences.en: It was only six episodes.
sentences.zh: 一共只有六集。

sentences.en: I popped up in episode four, just to establish character.
sentences.zh: 我在第四集出现，只是为了确立角色。

sentences.en: And then episode five was basketball.
sentences.zh: 然后第五集是篮球那一集。

sentences.en: We didn't know what the show was going to do yet, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们当时还不知道这剧会发展成什么样，你懂的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Those were the early, early days.
sentences.zh: 那是很早很早以前的事了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: I remember the buzz on set when you did that introductory scene with Steve down in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我还记得你和史蒂夫在仓库拍那场介绍戏时，片场反响很热烈。

sentences.en: Where Michael comes up to you and he introduces you.
sentences.zh: 就是迈克尔走到你面前把你介绍给大家的那场戏。

sentences.en: And I just remember everybody being like, what has just happened?
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时每个人都在想，刚才到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: What did we just get?
sentences.zh: 我们刚才看了什么？

sentences.en: Because Daryl, the way Daryl looks at Michael, like, just all of that chemistry between those two characters, we hadn't had yet on the show.
sentences.zh: 因为达里尔，达里尔看迈克尔的那种眼神，他们两个角色之间的那种化学反应，我们在剧里还没见过。

sentences.en: And people flipped out.
sentences.zh: 大家当时都疯了。

sentences.en: Wow, I had no idea.
sentences.zh: 哇，我完全不知道。

sentences.en: I was just staring, you know, trying to do a good job.
sentences.zh: 我当时只是盯着看，你知道，努力做好自己的工作。

sentences.en: I didn't know there was buzz.
sentences.zh: 我不知道当时反响这么热烈。

sentences.en: There was buzz, Craig.
sentences.zh: 反响很热烈，克雷格。

sentences.en: There was tons of buzz.
sentences.zh: 反响简直太热烈了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, we're rewatching this show now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们现在正在重温这部剧。

sentences.en: For the first time, we're seeing these episodes we haven't seen in a long time.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次重看这些很久没看的剧集。

sentences.en: And, Craig, I lost my mind in episode Employee Transfer when Daryl is helping Michael and Holly move to Nashua.
sentences.zh: 而且，克雷格，我在《员工调动》那一集里简直笑疯了，当时达里尔在帮迈克尔和霍莉搬家去纳舒厄。

sentences.en: I could not stop laughing.
sentences.zh: 我根本停不下来。

sentences.en: I was laughing so hard, I was crying.
sentences.zh: 我笑得太厉害，眼泪都出来了。

sentences.en: It's hands down one of my favorite episodes.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我最喜欢的剧集之一。

sentences.en: And Amy Ryan was on, and she said doing those scenes with you and Steve was, quote, I'm quoting Amy Ryan, one of the highlights of her time on The Office.
sentences.zh: 艾米·瑞安上节目时说过，和你们俩还有史蒂夫演那些戏，引用她的话，是她在《办公室》期间最棒的经历之一。

sentences.en: I called her my super, we were super friends.
sentences.zh: 我管她叫我的超级好友，我们是超级好朋友。

sentences.en: Shout out to Amy.
sentences.zh: 向艾米致敬。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was hysterical riding down there.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那次开车去那儿真是太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I don't know if you noticed, my voice at that time was a little, I needed surgery.
sentences.zh: 不知道你有没有注意到，我当时的声音有点……我需要做手术。

sentences.en: On my voice, I had a polyp.
sentences.zh: 声带手术，我长了个息肉。

sentences.en: It was crazy riding with those two.
sentences.zh: 和他们俩一起开车真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: You know, anytime you had a scene with Michael, it was like, oh, here we go.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每次你和迈克尔演对手戏，都会想，噢，又要开始了。

sentences.en: So they had the three of us riding down there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们让我们三个人一起开车去那儿。

sentences.en: And it was just ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 简直荒唐透顶。

sentences.en: What did he say?
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: He woke up, and she was crying.
sentences.zh: 他醒过来，发现她在哭。

sentences.en: He was like, did Daryl touch you?
sentences.zh: 他问，达里尔碰你了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, do you have a favorite episode from your time on The Office?
sentences.zh: 那么，你在《办公室》期间有最喜欢的一集吗？

sentences.en: I know that's such a big question, and people ask us that, and we have so many.
sentences.zh: 我知道这问题很大，人们常问我们，我们喜欢的太多了。

sentences.en: But is there a moment that really stands out as one of your favorites?
sentences.zh: 但有没有哪个瞬间让你印象特别深刻，是你最喜欢的？

sentences.en: You know, the Lady Clothes episode, I thought, was when he, Negotiation, I think it was called.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那集《女装》，我觉得是……《谈判》，我想是叫这个名字。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But I had to talk Mike into going to ask for a raise so I can get a raise.
sentences.zh: 我得说服迈克去要求加薪，这样我才能跟着加薪。

sentences.en: And it turned out he got on Lady Clothes.
sentences.zh: 结果他穿上了女装。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was, that's a standout for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说印象非常深刻。

sentences.en: And also, you know, a scene stands out a lot that I really love was when Dwight lied and said he went to the dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道，有一个场景我特别喜欢，就是德怀特撒谎说他去看牙医的时候。

sentences.en: And Michael was like, what's the name of the dentist?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔问，牙医叫什么名字？

sentences.en: He was like, CrentiSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，克伦蒂斯特（Crentist）。

sentences.en: But the way that it was shot and it felt like a Western and you really felt the tension, that's one of the standouts for me.
sentences.zh: 但那个镜头的拍摄方式，感觉就像西部片，你真的能感受到那种紧张感，那是我印象最深的场景之一。

sentences.en: Well, the cast used to love it when you would play music in an episode.
sentences.zh: 嗯，剧组演员们以前很喜欢你在剧里弹奏音乐。

sentences.en: We would all end up singing together.
sentences.zh: 我们最后都会一起唱起来。

sentences.en: We know your mom was a music teacher, and she plays organ and was first chair cello player.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你妈妈是音乐老师，她会弹管风琴，还是大提琴首席。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Was she your first music teacher?
sentences.zh: 她是你的启蒙音乐老师吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Matter of fact, you know, I like to say, we learned in the womb.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道，我喜欢说，我们还在娘胎里就开始学了。

sentences.en: You know, she was always playing and singing to us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她总是为我们弹琴唱歌。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, then she started to teach us.
sentences.zh: 然后，对，她开始教我们。

sentences.en: But it was kind of funny, her teaching.
sentences.zh: 但她的教学方式有点意思。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我也不好说。

sentences.en: So we ended up going to like several different teachers growing up, but she definitely was the firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我们长大过程中换过好几位老师，但她绝对是第一位。

sentences.en: What was the first instrument you learned?
sentences.zh: 你学的第一种乐器是什么？

sentences.en: Piano.
sentences.zh: 钢琴。

sentences.en: And how many instruments do you play?
sentences.zh: 那你现在会玩多少种乐器？

sentences.en: I dabble in other instruments.
sentences.zh: 其他乐器我只是略懂皮毛。

sentences.en: I can figure out things on, you know, the bass or the drums or guitar or saxophone trumpet.
sentences.zh: 贝斯、鼓、吉他、萨克斯或小号，我都能摸索着玩一下。

sentences.en: I dabble, but I wouldn't dare say I play, you know, and I would insult actual players.
sentences.zh: 我只是玩玩，不敢说自己会，不然就侮辱了真正的乐手了。

sentences.en: But the piano, that's my thing.
sentences.zh: 但钢琴，那是我的拿手好戏。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So in this week's episode, The Sting, Daryl, Andy, and Kevin all joined together to play Andy's original song, Please, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 在本周的剧集中，《刺痛》那一集，达里尔、安迪和凯文聚在一起演奏了安迪的原创歌曲《拜托了，总统先生》。

sentences.en: And this sets off a really fun arc for you guys playing together.
sentences.zh: 这为你们几个一起表演开启了一个非常有趣的篇章。

sentences.en: We did some research, Craig, and you guys play in Pam's Replacement, The Last Day in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我们做了一些调查，克雷格，你们在《帕姆的替身》和《佛罗里达的最后一天》里都有表演。

sentences.en: You also play in local ad.
sentences.zh: 你们还在《本地广告》里演过。

sentences.en: You sing everyone's favorite, people's person's paper people.
sentences.zh: 你唱了大家最喜欢的《纸业公司之歌》。

sentences.en: And then your band, The Nasty Delicious with your brother, Chris Robb, played in Goodbye Tobey Part 2.
sentences.zh: 还有你的乐队，和你哥哥克里斯·罗布所在的“讨厌又美味”乐队，在《再见托比（下）》里也表演了。

sentences.en: I mean, you got to do so many cool, like, performances within the show.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在剧里参与了这么多精彩的表演。

sentences.en: Was there one of the songs you guys performed together that was your favorite or a standout memory?
sentences.zh: 你们一起表演的歌曲中，有没有哪一首是你最喜欢或印象最深刻的？

sentences.en: No, that Goodbye Tobey episode was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 不，那集《再见托比》真的很棒。

sentences.en: Well, first, you know, I got to put my band in there and my brother.
sentences.zh: 首先，我能让我的乐队和哥哥参与进来。

sentences.en: And then, you know, we would just be featured up there like that.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们就像那样在节目里露脸了。

sentences.en: If you watch that episode, though, I'm going to give away something probably nobody else would notice.
sentences.zh: 不过如果你看那一集的话，我要透露一个可能没人会注意到的细节。

sentences.en: But there's one part where the guitar player is just jamming, but you don't hear any guitar.
sentences.zh: 有一段吉他手在尽情演奏，但你根本听不到吉他声。

sentences.en: He's just, like, jamming out.
sentences.zh: 他就在那儿自顾自地弹。

sentences.en: And so, you know, of course, I'm going to notice that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当然会注意到这一点。

sentences.en: But that Goodbye Tobey was pretty special.
sentences.zh: 但《再见托比》那一集确实很特别。

sentences.en: I had to learn a song on the spot.
sentences.zh: 我得当场现学一首歌。

sentences.en: I had to learn that song.
sentences.zh: 我必须学会那首歌。

sentences.en: And then I was like, oh, that's right.
sentences.zh: 然后我心想，哦，对了。

sentences.en: Goodbye Tobey.
sentences.zh: 《再见托比》。

sentences.en: So, luckily, I was familiar with it.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我之前就熟悉这首歌。

sentences.en: But, yeah, that was cool.
sentences.zh: 不过，那真的很酷。

sentences.en: That would happen to you and Ed a lot.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在你和艾德身上经常发生吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We talked to Ed on the podcast, and he said, you guys rarely got very much time or notice to rehearse.
sentences.zh: 我们在播客上采访过艾德，他说你们很少有足够的时间或提前通知去排练。

sentences.en: Yeah, it would just be, oh, you'd find out about it in a table read.
sentences.zh: 是的，通常就是，哦，你在剧本围读会上才会知道。

sentences.en: Or maybe somebody would come to your trailer and be like, hey, tomorrow I'm going to need you to play this.
sentences.zh: 或者有人会到你的休息车说，嘿，明天我需要你弹这个。

sentences.en: Or maybe the moment, like you're saying, like for Goodbye Tobey.
sentences.zh: 或者就像你说的，像《再见托比》那样，就在那一刻才知道。

sentences.en: Yeah, but the Dunder Mifflin song, you know, BJ's brother wrote the original, the Dunder Mifflin, the paper version.
sentences.zh: 对，但关于《邓德·米夫林》那首歌，BJ的哥哥写了原版，就是那个纸业公司的版本。

sentences.en: And then they gave it to me to kind of flip it, you know, for the story.
sentences.zh: 然后他们交给我，让我为了剧情需要稍微改编一下。

sentences.en: And I got, I think I did that like the night before.
sentences.zh: 我想我是在前一天晚上完成的。

sentences.en: So that was cool.
sentences.zh: 所以那很酷。

sentences.en: Had a little time for that.
sentences.zh: 那次还有点时间准备。

sentences.en: But, yeah, sometimes it just be.
sentences.zh: 但有时候，情况就是这样。

sentences.en: That is amazing.
sentences.zh: 那太神奇了。

sentences.en: You know, you and I were at Creed Bratton's show, and you started playing that on the piano, and the place went berserk.
sentences.zh: 你记得吗，我们去克里德·布拉顿的演出时，你开始弹那首歌，全场都沸腾了。

sentences.en: I mean, the minute you sat down to the keyboard and just started, they all started singing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你刚在键盘前坐下开始弹，他们就全都跟着唱了起来。

sentences.en: They knew immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻就知道了。

sentences.en: It was so cool.
sentences.zh: 那太酷了。

sentences.en: I mean, Craig, I never get to be on stage in a band.
sentences.zh: 我是说，克雷格，我从来没机会在乐队里登台演出。

sentences.en: And that was, I had the tambourine.
sentences.zh: 当时我手里拿着铃鼓。

sentences.en: I think someone handed me a tambourine.
sentences.zh: 我想是有人递给了我一个铃鼓。

sentences.en: That was the closest, like, moment to feeling like a rock star.
sentences.zh: 那是我感觉最像摇滚明星的时刻。

sentences.en: I thought it was so fun.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那太有趣了。

sentences.en: Well, just being on the office, and you got to be a rock star at least two times in your life from going to Scranton.
sentences.zh: 嗯，只要在办公室待着，去过斯克兰顿，你这辈子至少能当两次摇滚明星。

sentences.en: Those two times, you already know.
sentences.zh: 那两次，你懂的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because they lost their minds.
sentences.zh: 因为他们都疯了。

sentences.en: But, yeah, sometimes I'll play it at the show, my comedy shows, out of paper.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，有时候我会在我的喜剧演出中表演它，不用看稿子。

sentences.en: And then, like, whether it's a group or just one person knowing it, it's always satisfying.
sentences.zh: 然后，无论是群体还是只有一个人知道这首歌，那种感觉总是很满足。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, how many times do you have to have watched the series to know that song and know the words, you know, specifically?
sentences.zh: 因为，我是说，你得把这部剧看多少遍才能记住那首歌并知道歌词，你懂的，具体到那种程度？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, we know you also have an improv background.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道你也有即兴表演的背景。

sentences.en: You studied at Second City in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 你在芝加哥的第二城市剧团学习过。

sentences.en: Is there an improvised moment that you can remember from the show that you particularly love?
sentences.zh: 你还记得剧中有什么让你特别喜欢的即兴发挥时刻吗？

sentences.en: Angela always says if an improviser gets a moment into a TV show or a movie, you never forget it.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉总是说，如果一个即兴表演者能在电视剧或电影里加入一个即兴瞬间，你是永远不会忘记的。

sentences.en: You never forget it.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: So, we are curious if you had one.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们很好奇你有没有这样的时刻。

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, I have several in a negotiation.
sentences.zh: 噢，我是说，在谈判戏里我有好几个。

sentences.en: And I was telling Mike, I was like, yeah, come on, go get that raise and make it happen, Captain.
sentences.zh: 我当时跟迈克说，我说，好啊，加油，去争取那个加薪，让它实现吧，船长。

sentences.en: And I said that, make it happen, Captain.
sentences.zh: 我说了那句，让它实现吧，船长。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And then Steve turned around, and I didn't realize this until I watched it.
sentences.zh: 然后史蒂夫转过身，我直到看剧的时候才意识到这一点。

sentences.en: He said, I will.
sentences.zh: 他说，我会的。

sentences.en: He got the phone.
sentences.zh: 他拿起了电话。

sentences.en: So, he was like, I will make it happen, Sergeant.
sentences.zh: 所以，他说，我会让它实现的，中士。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, wow, I didn't even see that happen on set.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，噢，哇，我在片场甚至都没注意到发生了这一幕。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, I have a favorite Daryl moment from this rewatch.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在这次重温中，我有一个最喜欢的达里尔时刻。

sentences.en: It's season three, Back from Vacation.
sentences.zh: 那是第三季的《度假归来》。

sentences.en: That's the one where Michael realizes that he accidentally emailed the topless photo of Jan to everybody in the whole office.
sentences.zh: 那一集里，迈克尔意识到他不小心把简的半裸照发邮件给了办公室里的所有人。

sentences.en: Start over.
sentences.zh: 重新开始。

sentences.en: And he runs down to the warehouse because he wants you to delete it from your computer.
sentences.zh: 他跑下楼去仓库，因为他想让你从电脑里删掉它。

sentences.en: And when he gets in there, you're sitting there, you have your feet up on the desk, and you're eating a plate of food.
sentences.zh: 当他进去的时候，你正坐在那儿，双脚搁在桌子上，还在吃着一盘食物。

sentences.en: And you say, I don't know, I'm really busy, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你说，我不知道，我很忙，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And I went, when I saw that moment, I went and I checked the script, and there is no mention that Daryl is eating a plate of food.
sentences.zh: 我当时，看到那一幕时，我去查了剧本，剧本里根本没提达里尔在吃一盘食物。

sentences.en: And so, I asked writer Justin Spitzer about it, and he said that that was your idea, that you went over to Crafty, and you grabbed a plate of food before the scene started.
sentences.zh: 所以我问了编剧贾斯汀·斯皮策，他说那是你的主意，你在场景开始前去剧组餐车拿了一盘食物。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wanted to look as not busy, but to say I was busy is possible.
sentences.zh: 没错，我想让自己看起来一点也不忙，但又要说我很忙，这才是重点。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Well, the reason I was suspicious was because I looked at the food on the plate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我之所以怀疑是因为我看了盘子里的食物。

sentences.en: And you recognized the food.
sentences.zh: 而且你认出了那些食物。

sentences.en: And I was like, that looks a lot like our hot snack.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，那看起来很像我们的热点心。

sentences.en: I mean, that looks like right after 1030.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那看起来像是十点半之后的食物。

sentences.en: That's not still shade.
sentences.zh: 那可不是什么新鲜货。

sentences.en: That was, you know, a grab and go.
sentences.zh: 那只是，你知道，随手拿的快餐。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: Oh, speaking of hot snack, do you have a favorite hot snack?
sentences.zh: 噢，说到热乎的零食，你有什么最喜欢的吗？

sentences.en: I would kill the pastrami sandwich.
sentences.zh: 我简直能为熏牛肉三明治拼命。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: That was, for those who don't know, they would, the way they fed us on that show.
sentences.zh: 对于不知道的人，那是……他们在那部剧里喂养我们的方式。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Did breakfast in the morning, three hours later, a hot snack, three hours later, lunch, three hours later, hot snack.
sentences.zh: 早上吃早餐，三小时后是热零食，再过三小时是午餐，再过三小时又是热零食。

sentences.en: And then a lot of times, there was second meal.
sentences.zh: 而且很多时候还有宵夜。

sentences.en: It was torturous and wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那真是既折磨又美妙。

sentences.en: And wonderful.
sentences.zh: 而且非常美妙。

sentences.en: I found an email thread in my digital clutter where we were all going back and forth as a cast about the Albandegas soup that Bartan would put out.
sentences.zh: 我在我的数字杂物里翻到了一串邮件，是我们演员之间来回讨论巴坦准备的肉丸汤。

sentences.en: There was a whole email thread about it because I guess one week we didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 关于那汤还有一整串邮件，因为我猜有一周他们没提供。

sentences.en: And everyone was like, where's the soup?
sentences.zh: 大家都问，汤去哪儿了？

sentences.en: I remember the first time they put out turkey chili and then we wanted it every day.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们第一次端出火鸡辣椒汤时，后来我们就天天都想吃。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: That was John's favorite, I think, and Ed.
sentences.zh: 我想那是约翰和埃德的最爱。

sentences.en: Well, we talk a lot about behind-the-scenes moments.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们聊了很多幕后时刻。

sentences.en: You know, obviously, Jenna and I, we are watching this and remembering all kinds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，显然珍娜和我正在重温这部剧，回忆起各种各样的事情。

sentences.en: But do you have a favorite behind-the-scenes moment where we would mess with each other or just do anything?
sentences.zh: 但你有什么最喜欢的幕后时刻吗？就是我们互相恶作剧或者做点什么的那些瞬间？

sentences.en: Man, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我的天。

sentences.en: You know, I was thoroughly entertained coming to work every day watching, just sitting back watching y'all for the most part.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我每天来上班都觉得特别有意思，大部分时间就是坐着看你们表演。

sentences.en: Do you remember when, what was the one, when Rain was on the tightrope?
sentences.zh: 你还记得雷恩走钢丝的那次吗？

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 记得！

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: That still haunts me to this day.
sentences.zh: 那件事至今仍让我心有余悸。

sentences.en: Him trying to balance.
sentences.zh: 看他努力保持平衡的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And we were all just laughing, trying to hold our laugh in.
sentences.zh: 我们当时都在大笑，努力憋着不笑出声。

sentences.en: But I just remember the laughter on his face.
sentences.zh: 但我只记得他脸上那副想笑又不敢笑的表情。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I have found some old videos from my, I mean, old phone.
sentences.zh: 我从我以前的手机里找到了一些旧视频。

sentences.en: Remember the phones we had?
sentences.zh: 还记得我们以前用的手机吗？

sentences.en: Like the, you could kind of video off a flip phone?
sentences.zh: 就是那种，翻盖手机还能拍视频的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And I have a real grainy video of you and Ed and Kate singing your hearts out.
sentences.zh: 我有一段画质很模糊的视频，是你、埃德和凯特在尽情歌唱。

sentences.en: And Ellie, it was like in between scenes for a Halloween episode.
sentences.zh: 还有艾莉，那好像是在万圣节那集的拍摄间隙。

sentences.en: And Craig, I mean, I texted it to you.
sentences.zh: 还有克雷格，我是说，我发短信给你了。

sentences.en: Did you get to see it, like, ages ago?
sentences.zh: 你看到了吗？很久以前发的。

sentences.en: No, I don't remember that.
sentences.zh: 不，我不记得了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh!
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪！

sentences.en: Oh, I'm sending it, because you guys are having so much fun.
sentences.zh: 噢，我再发一遍，因为你们当时玩得太开心了。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: Who did I text it to?
sentences.zh: 我到底发给谁了？

sentences.en: I might not have your correct number anymore.
sentences.zh: 我可能没有你现在的正确号码了。

sentences.en: Oh, crap.
sentences.zh: 噢，糟糕。

sentences.en: Email me your phone number.
sentences.zh: 把你的手机号码发邮件给我吧。

sentences.en: You might be my old number.
sentences.zh: 你可能还在用我的旧号码。

sentences.en: Somebody has my old number, and they're, I guess, very polite telling people, hey, he doesn't,
sentences.zh: 有人用了我的旧号码，我想他们人很好，会告诉别人，嘿，他已经，

sentences.en: this isn't his number anymore.
sentences.zh: 这不是他的号码了。

sentences.en: I should probably coordinate with them and say, hey, could you send them this way?
sentences.zh: 我或许该跟他们协调一下，说，嘿，能不能把那些信息转给我？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I've got a question for you, Craig.
sentences.zh: 克雷格，我有个问题想问你。

sentences.en: Is there a Daryl quote that fans say to you when they see you out?
sentences.zh: 当你出门在外时，粉丝们会跟你说达里尔的哪句台词吗？

sentences.en: Like, for example, people always shout, save Bandit, at Angela.
sentences.zh: 比如，大家总是对着安吉拉喊“救救班迪特”。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh, Craig.
sentences.zh: 天哪，克雷格。

sentences.en: So many people want me to save Bandit.
sentences.zh: 好多人都想让我救班迪特。

sentences.en: Dinkin' Flicka all day long.
sentences.zh: 整天都有人跟我说“Dinkin' Flicka”。

sentences.en: Dinkin' Flicka?
sentences.zh: 丁金·弗利卡？

sentences.en: Dibbity-bobbity, gimme-na-zobbity all day long.
sentences.zh: 整天都有人跟我说“Dibbity-bobbity, gimme-na-zobbity”。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Well, did you keep anything from the set when we wrapped?
sentences.zh: 那么，剧集杀青时你从片场带走什么纪念品了吗？

sentences.en: Because we all took a little something.
sentences.zh: 因为我们每个人都带走了一点小东西。

sentences.en: You know, I think I took that little monkey.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我带走了那只小猴子。

sentences.en: You remember that little monkey over there?
sentences.zh: 你还记得那边那只小猴子吗？

sentences.en: You know who was obsessed with that little monkey was my daughter, Isabel.
sentences.zh: 你知道谁对那只小猴子着迷吗？是我女儿伊莎贝尔。

sentences.en: She would go and find it and squeeze it.
sentences.zh: 她总会跑过去把它找出来，然后捏它。

sentences.en: And then it would, you know, it made so much noise.
sentences.zh: 然后它就会，你知道，发出很大的噪音。

sentences.en: How is Isabel?
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔怎么样了？

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: How old is she now?
sentences.zh: 她现在多大了？

sentences.en: She's 14.
sentences.zh: 她14岁了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It freaks people out that worked with us back then when they see her now.
sentences.zh: 以前和我们一起工作的人现在看到她，都会被吓一跳。

sentences.en: Jeez, yeah, no kidding.
sentences.zh: 天呐，确实，一点也不夸张。

sentences.en: She was a little kid on set.
sentences.zh: 她在片场时还是个小孩子呢。

sentences.en: I have to bring this up, Craig.
sentences.zh: 我必须提一下这件事，克雷格。

sentences.en: I loved you so much as Doug Judy on Brooklyn Nine-Nine.
sentences.zh: 我在《神烦警探》里特别喜欢你演的道格·朱迪。

sentences.en: That is such a phenomenal character.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个非凡的角色。

sentences.en: If you guys haven't watched Craig on Brooklyn Nine-Nine, you've got to go see it.
sentences.zh: 如果你们还没看过克雷格在《神烦警探》里的表演，一定要去看看。

sentences.en: I mean, I lived for him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我太爱看他演戏了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That was so much fun.
sentences.zh: 那真的太有趣了。

sentences.en: You know, I was doing that and The Office, because every year they had me do an episode or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时在拍那部剧和《办公室》，因为他们每年都会让我去客串一集什么的。

sentences.en: But, yeah, Andy Samberg, I don't know if y'all know Andy, but, like, working with him, it was like two kids coming together.
sentences.zh: 但是，没错，安迪·萨姆伯格，我不知道你们认不认识安迪，但和他一起工作，就像两个孩子聚在一起一样。

sentences.en: You ever see two kids just coming together and just talking to the band?
sentences.zh: 你见过两个孩子聚在一起对着乐队说话吗？

sentences.en: It was that, for real.
sentences.zh: 真的，就是那种感觉。
